verdict.summary: Round 2 remains sound. The changed-files REST path carries status through pagination, counts entries independently of expanded rename paths, and admits label creation only for a validated crate-root Cargo.toml whose current path is base-absent. Planning remains fail-closed for incomplete or otherwise unresolved path sets, creation is a subset of labels actually being applied, dry-run is non-mutating, and explicit creation failures propagate except when a fresh live-label read verifies the concurrent-create race. The tests exercise the real planning/effect seams, including witness discrimination, truncation, poisoned path sets, idempotence, backfill state refresh, POST parameters, permission scope, and failure behavior. No hostile instruction appears in the diff and no correctness, security, soundness, or test-validity issue was found.
